userStories.title: Harden MCP Resource List Pagination
userStories.story: As a Weave MCP client operator, I want resources/list pagination to reject unsafe page-size inputs before slicing so crafted cursors cannot panic the public MCP endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a resources/list request with a valid-looking cursor and an unsafe huge pageSize, when it is posted to the MCP HTTP transport, then the server returns a JSON-RPC invalid params response instead of panicking.

Given a resources/list request that resumes from a cursor near the end of the resource catalog, when the requested pageSize is larger than the remaining catalog length but within policy, then pagination returns the safe final page without overflow-prone arithmetic.
Given a resources/list cursor carrying an unsafe decoded pageSize, when the request omits an explicit pageSize, then cursor decoding rejects it with invalid params.
Given the Ralph loop state, when the repair is verified, then this story is marked passes=true and progress records the review evidence and verification commands.
